candidateIdentity.runtimeCandidate: Exact source/tree/runtime digest used by live qualification.
candidateIdentity.distributionCandidate: Exact native package and OCI digest set produced from that source.
candidateIdentity.productionCandidate: Separately human-approved, production-signed bytes; never inferred from development candidates.

completionChecker.rule: Run once excluding P17-T07 before its checkpoint, then rerun without exclusion after the pushed checkpoint.

repairProtocol.idAllocation: Append the next unused repair task ID in the active phase.
repairProtocol.parentTransition: Move the failing parent out of in_progress while the repair runs.
repairProtocol.repairDependencies: Depend on the parent's already-satisfied dependencies, never on the blocked parent itself.
repairProtocol.resume: After repair checkpoint/push, add the repair as a parent dependency and resume the parent.
repairProtocol.candidateEffect: Invalidate runtime and distribution candidates and rerun affected plus final cases.

tasks.title: Promote the unified product contract and rebaseline task state
acceptance: Workspace and Repository current docs define one product and the new read order.
A resumable owner-only campaign context exists before verification/build and inventories external gates without values.
P12 supersessions are explicit and completed history is unchanged.
next-task selects P13-T01 instead of old P12-T09.
Repository documentation tests and full verify pass.

tasks.title: Add task-state reconciliation and machine Goal completion checks
acceptance: A pushed task commit can repair an in-progress state without a duplicate commit.
Dynamic repair allocation blocks the parent, depends only on satisfied predecessors, then adds the pushed repair as a parent dependency and resumes it without a cycle.
Blocked, skipped, manual, pending, and NO_READY_TASK states cannot be mistaken for completion.
Completion checker supports the P17-T07 pre-check exclusion and mandatory post-checkpoint run while verifying origin sync, candidate identity, evidence, cleanup, and clean Repository.

tasks.title: Define unified product, runtime profile, capability, and release identity contracts
acceptance: Contracts expose one product and native/docker profiles.
Internal components report one version, commit, channel, and target identity.
Old public Desktop/Headless/CLI/Service selectors fail schema tests.

tasks.title: Move all mutable state to the shared home-root layout with migration
acceptance: Native resolves only ~/.cmclient and Docker resolves /home/cmclient/.cmclient.
Old platform locations copy, verify, journal, resume, and never auto-delete.
Gateway receives absolute Agent-owned paths and cannot choose a divergent root.
Migration integrity and interrupted-phase tests pass.

tasks.title: Make plaintext secrets.json the only cross-platform secret backend
acceptance: Keyring, DPAPI, Secret Service, and systemd vault runtime paths are removed.
Atomic JSON write, schema/size checks, reset, redaction, and Windows/POSIX E2E pass.
No strict hardlink/cross-principal ACL audit blocks normal startup.
Secret scan covers argv, logs, APIs, Web storage, diagnostics, evidence, and package fixtures.

tasks.title: Add versioned writable config, terms, setup, and reset transaction contracts
acceptance: Agent owns versioned config and SetupStatus schemas with atomic transactions.
Terms version/time, setup generation, reset retention, and recovery state are tested.
Public config/status schemas contain no secret or private identity value.

tasks.title: Align private Control IPC with the current-user unified product
acceptance: Windows named pipe and Unix sockets remain local and never fall back to TCP.
Graphical and command modes complete same-user product E2E through Control.
Endpoints and errors are bounded/redacted and do not disclose identity or secrets.

tasks.title: Bind native Web on all interfaces with default loopback admission
acceptance: Native listener binds 0.0.0.0 and IPv6 when supported but advertises loopback URL.
Non-loopback peers are rejected before static/setup/API/SSE and forwarded headers are ignored.
LAN enable requires password session, CSRF/Origin/rate limit/audit and disable invalidates sessions.

tasks.title: Create one user-facing launcher and command dispatch contract
acceptance: cmclient without arguments opens/focuses graphical mode on native targets.
cmclient with a command uses Control API and --background starts no visible window.
Internal GUI/Agent binaries stay one versioned product and second launch is single-instance safe.

tasks.title: Bundle and launch a pinned private Node Gateway runtime
acceptance: Exact Node 24 LTS and target production dependencies are checksum-pinned.
Agent launches absolute packaged resources with system Node/npm/PATH absent.
Native addons load on every built target and runtime identity appears in SBOM inputs.

tasks.title: Run the full P13 runtime and contract verification gate
acceptance: Affected, adjacent, full verify, secret scan, and cross-platform contract CI pass.
Current docs and machine schemas contain no incompatible old product claim.

tasks.title: Implement mandatory setup state and safe Meshtastic/CallMesh validation
acceptance: Missing, invalid, revoked, reset, and terms-change states enter setupRequired without skip.
Discovery uses bounded loopback/migrated/mDNS candidates and performs no LAN sweep/RF/radio mutation.
CallMesh validation/provision transaction starts Gateway only after ready and stops APRS on rejection.

tasks.title: Expose Agent-owned setup-only API, jobs, and event contracts
acceptance: Setup status, discovery, validation, finish, reset, and progress use shared typed contracts.
Normal operational routes remain inaccessible before ready.
All error codes are stable and responses are secret/identity redacted.

tasks.title: Build the complete low-friction Web setup wizard
acceptance: Wizard covers language, terms, detection, required key, defaults, validation, and finish.
It resumes safely, hides advanced fields by default, and has no product-surface choices.
Playwright covers fresh, invalid, revoked, terms-change, reset, offline, and recovery flows.

tasks.title: Implement operational reset and isolated factory-reset jobs
acceptance: Operational reset clears config/secrets/terms and preserves DB/history/backups/autostart.
Reset increments setupGeneration, cancels active Jobs, and fences all old-generation writes, connections, and transmissions.
Factory reset is a separate two-confirmation durable job tested only in isolated roots.
Interrupted reset resumes/rolls back and never runs during uninstall/update failure.

tasks.title: Implement current-user login autostart providers and Web controls
acceptance: Windows HKCU, macOS SMAppService, and Linux XDG/systemd-user providers are idempotent.
Default login launch is background-only; Web and command mode enable/disable/status real state.
Pending/denied and stale-path repair are honest; Linux providers cannot double-register.

tasks.title: Integrate graphical tray, close, setup, and resident-core lifecycle
acceptance: Graphical UI remains compact and opens full Web for complete workflows.
Native/red close hides; exit graphical ends only UI; stop-now ends core without changing autostart.
Repeated close/open/second-launch has no duplicate process, lock, or Gateway.

tasks.title: Add Agent-owned update trigger, preference, Job, and surface controls
acceptance: Web/graphical/command trigger Agent check/stage/install and share Job/SSE state.
Default install requires confirmation and automatic install is explicit opt-in.
Gateway cannot update itself and update state remains available while Gateway is stopped.

tasks.title: Expose operational backup, cancel, retry, restore, and rollback
acceptance: Agent-owned product workflows create, verify, cancel, retry, and restore backups.
Ordinary backup excludes secrets.json, run state, update staging, credentials, and pending setup sessions.
SQLite backup API with a bounded WAL checkpoint creates a schema-journaled snapshot; foreign-key/integrity/domain counts pass and failed restore restores prior state.
Restore revalidates credentials and enters setupRequired when they are absent or invalid; reset increments a generation and fences stale jobs.
Web and command mode expose the same durable Job and stable errors.

tasks.title: Share one Meshtastic upstream session across ingest and Proxy clients
acceptance: Exactly one TCP/config session and serialized upstream writer exist.
Two clients pass config replay, routing/ACK ownership, slow-client isolation, and reconnect cases.
No duplicate or missing domain event appears across restart/reconnect fixtures.

tasks.title: Select CallMesh mapping version by trusted source event time
acceptance: Trusted GPS event time selects the effective mapping; sequence only breaks supported ties.
Receive/server time never selects callsign and unknown applicability fails closed.
Late, backlog, rotate, same-time, restart, and multi-iGate fixtures are deterministic.

tasks.title: Require matching APRS-IS verified logresp before transmission
acceptance: Verified matching provision identity is required before any APRS Data leaves.
Unverified, reject, timeout, malformed, mismatch, reconnect, and stale-provision cases fail closed.
Outbox cannot mark delivery before verified session acceptance.

tasks.title: Run the full setup, lifecycle, and retained-defect product gate
acceptance: Fresh-to-ready, reset-to-ready, tray, command, backup/update, Mesh/Proxy/CallMesh/APRS E2E pass.
Affected, adjacent, full verify, load, and secret scan pass.

tasks.title: Establish cross-target build workflows and candidate signing profiles
acceptance: Cross-target workflow skeletons build from exact source without downloading or reconstructing GitHub artifact payloads.
Development/test-signing profiles are distinct from production signing, notarization, tag, and publication gates.
Each output declares target, source, runtimeCandidate, distributionCandidate, and verification capability without false platform claims.

tasks.title: Assemble the self-contained native unified runtime
acceptance: One native package staging tree contains launcher, UI, Agent, Node/Gateway, Web, updater, licenses.
All components report exact matching identity and run without development/system runtimes.
No public Desktop/Headless/CLI/Service subpackage remains.

tasks.title: Implement external native updater watchdog and health rollback
acceptance: Candidate/test-signed helper runs outside the replaced version, journals every phase, and retains the prior payload; production trust is a manual lane.
Kill-at-phase, corrupt/signature/digest/version mismatch, install failure, and unhealthy start roll back.
Update snapshots exclude secrets/run/staging/sessions; the live secret file remains untouched while state/config/backups/autostart survive update and rollback.

tasks.title: Produce one current-user Windows Setup executable
acceptance: Only CMClient-Setup.exe is public; NSIS currentUser and offline WebView2 are enforced.
HKCU PATH/startup, shortcuts, program layout, upgrade, uninstall retention, and signing manifests pass.
Normal install/login/update requires no UAC.

tasks.title: Qualify the Windows x64 candidate package and lifecycle lab
acceptance: The exact x64 Setup candidate passes clean-profile install, lifecycle, update, rollback, and uninstall fixtures on an applicable Windows runner and the current lab.
Windows Server and CI results remain exactly labeled and do not claim a real Windows 11 target.
Candidate-byte digests and signing policy evidence are recorded without secrets; production-signed bytes remain a manual gate.

tasks.title: Build Universal macOS runtime resources and candidate-signing workflow
acceptance: Rust, Node, every native addon, and every dylib have both CPU slices or an explicit per-architecture resource tree with upstream and derived digests.
Candidate/ad-hoc signing exercises inside-out order and the minimum Node JIT entitlement without requiring production credentials.
Private runtime/native addons execute in architecture-specific CI or package fixtures; real-target evidence is separate.

tasks.title: Produce one Universal DMG with terminal and SMAppService integration
acceptance: One candidate DMG contains one app and Applications drag target; production notarization/stapling is a separately executable manual profile.
User-level zsh/bash/fish command integration is idempotent/reversible and needs no admin.
SMAppService reports enabled/pending/denied/disabled and repairs update/move paths.

tasks.title: Qualify the Universal DMG structure and lifecycle fixtures
acceptance: Universal slices, bundle structure, launch, login, terminal, update/permission failure/rollback, and retention pass on applicable CI/package fixtures.
Gatekeeper/notarization steps are verified by workflow/policy tests and remain pending as real production evidence without credentials.

tasks.title: Build the Linux x86-64 AppImage product
acceptance: x86-64 AppImage contains the unified runtime and baseline-compatible glibc/WebKitGTK assets.
Normal and extraction fallback launch plus native addons pass on declared x86-64 targets.

tasks.title: Build the Linux ARM64 AppImage product
acceptance: ARM64 AppImage is built and validated on a native-capable CI target and is not inferred from x86-64.
Normal launch where FUSE is available and the operator --appimage-extract-and-run fallback plus native addons pass on declared ARM64 fixtures.

tasks.title: Implement and verify Linux user integration and AppImage rollback fixtures
acceptance: Versioned user install, stable command, desktop/icon, PATH, and one autostart provider pass in applicable CI/package fixtures.
FUSE/operator extraction fallback, update, rollback, uninstall retention, and serial permission diagnostics are verified without claiming an untested real host.

tasks.title: Run the native install, migration, update, rollback, and retention matrix
acceptance: All required build/fixture rows have exact package evidence; real foreign-target and production-signing rows remain explicitly pending.
Clean install, old-path migration, upgrade, rollback, uninstall, reinstall, setup/reset, and autostart pass.

tasks.title: Run the full native distribution verification gate
acceptance: Native affected/adjacent/full verify, package identity, signatures, load, and secret scan pass.
No external runtime or obsolete public artifact is required.

tasks.title: Manually qualify native packages on real foreign targets
acceptance: Run only when real Windows 11, macOS Intel/Apple Silicon, and Linux x86-64/ARM64 hosts are available.
Record exact installed package evidence per target; never infer it from CI, cross-builds, or the current Windows Server host.

tasks.title: Replace Docker with one non-root unified container under a minimal init
acceptance: One service/container uses Compose init:true with tini as PID1, an exec-form Agent child, Gateway child, Web, and cmclient command mode.
Old Node entrypoint, gateway/web/ingress services, and Docker-excludes-Agent contracts are removed.
Non-root/read-only/cap-drop/no-new-privileges/no-socket/device/host modes pass inspection.

tasks.title: Implement Docker state, local access, setup, and Compose contract
acceptance: State lives only at /home/cmclient/.cmclient and UID 10001 can atomically write it.
Host publish is explicit 127.0.0.1 by default; every Docker Web session requires application authentication regardless of peer address.
A one-time setup code is obtained only through docker compose exec -T cmclient cmclient setup-code, never logs, environment, URLs, diagnostics, or evidence; LAN also requires widened host mapping.
setupRequired remains healthy and volume survives restart/recreate/down without volumes.

tasks.title: Qualify Docker init signals, reaping, health, and restart behavior
acceptance: Compose init/tini forwards SIGTERM, reaps descendants, and Agent performs bounded Gateway shutdown without zombies across repeated crashes.
Health is read-only; setupRequired is live; fatal Agent exit increments Docker restart count.

tasks.title: Qualify Docker command, setup, Web, backup, restore, and state E2E
acceptance: docker compose exec command mode uses Control for all supported workflows.
Default loopback publish, authenticated widened publish, setup-code/reset, DB, backup/restore, and redaction pass.
Engine older than 28 fails local-only qualification rather than producing a false pass.

tasks.title: Build and verify one amd64/arm64 OCI candidate index
acceptance: One index has exactly linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 manifests and runtime selection/identity pass in architecture-capable CI or controlled emulation.
Rust/Node/native addon load tests are target-specific; no emulated or cross-built result is labeled real native evidence.
Index and child digests are captured for supply-chain binding.

tasks.title: Implement and qualify Docker pull/recreate digest rollback
acceptance: Good update preserves volume and exact identity; unhealthy update pins/recreates prior digest.
Container has no self-update or Docker API path and old image remains through the health gate.

tasks.title: Replace the release artifact schema with unified public objects
acceptance: Release index exposes Setup, Universal DMG, two AppImages, one OCI index, and Compose only.
Update support files are distinguished from user install choices.
Old archive/MSI/DEB/component selectors and docs fail/remove through contract tests.

tasks.title: Rebuild cross-platform build, signing, and package workflows
acceptance: Native and Docker matrices build each target with target-specific runtime dependencies.
Unsigned/ad-hoc/test-signed candidate paths remain honest; production signing/notarization is a separate human workflow that creates new bytes.
Workflow identity and required-job policy reject missing or substituted targets.

tasks.title: Bind exact candidate bytes and OCI digests to checksums, SBOM, provenance, and updates
acceptance: Checksums/SBOM/provenance reference exact candidate native files and OCI index/children with explicit signing status.
Native update manifest excludes Docker and accepts only verified exact-target candidate payloads; production signatures require a separate finalization rerun.
Post-attestation repack or identity mismatch fails closed.

tasks.title: Run the complete cross-platform package and Docker matrix
acceptance: Every required candidate build/fixture target has exact V0-V2 evidence; real foreign/native V3 rows remain optional/manual and explicitly pending.
Applicable install/setup/access/autostart/update/rollback/uninstall/state and Docker candidate matrices pass.

tasks.title: Run the full unified release verification gate
acceptance: Full verify, policy, package, Docker, load, supply-chain, docs, and secret scans pass.
No formal main/tag/sign/publish action is performed.

tasks.title: Manually qualify the Docker image on real amd64 and arm64 hosts
acceptance: Run the exact OCI child digest on real amd64 and arm64 hosts and record native runtime/package evidence.
Do not infer real arm64 qualification from cross-build, QEMU, manifest inspection, or another platform.

tasks.title: Revalidate live testability gates in the isolated Windows campaign
acceptance: All TG-01 through TG-12 gates pass against exact local source.

The Goal bootstrap inventory records missing external hosts, signing credentials, Docker, hardware, and live inputs without values; missing optional/manual gates do not stop independent implementation.
The owner-user temp root created before the first build contains every campaign output and child product HOME/USERPROFILE/TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR; no real secret value enters workspace/evidence.
Approved endpoint/credential availability is checked without printing values or external mutation.

tasks.title: Qualify live Meshtastic TCP, CallMesh provision, and verified APRS-IS
acceptance: Passive TCP 4403 config/live/reconnect and sanitized replay pass without RF/radio changes.
Legacy-compatible CallMesh heartbeat/mapping/provision and matching verified APRS login pass.
Only authorized provision-derived APRS flow occurs and all evidence is sanitized.

tasks.title: Qualify multi-client Proxy, full Web, graphical mode, and command mode
acceptance: At least two local Proxy clients share one upstream and pass routing/slow/reconnect/order cases.
Every full Web workflow, compact graphical control, and command path uses the same resident Agent.
Repeated lifecycle operations produce no duplicate process, event, DB write, or APRS output.

tasks.title: Qualify persistence, restore, update, rollback, reset retention, and recovery
acceptance: Restart/WAL/integrity, product backup/restore, operational reset retention, and re-setup pass.
SQLite backup API manifests, exclusion of secrets/run/staging/sessions, staged restore, credential revalidation, and generation-fenced reset pass.
Candidate/test-signed local update lab covers interrupted phases, unhealthy candidate, and exact prior-version rollback.
No user real state or production release resource is mutated.

tasks.title: Complete the 24-hour unified-product live soak
acceptance: A continuous 24-hour run records bounded health/RSS/handles/threads/DB/WAL/log/upstream metrics.
No duplicate domain/APRS event, position rollback, secret leak, unbounded growth, or orphan remains.
Transient failures recover within documented budgets and every product defect enters the repair loop.

tasks.title: Freeze a new candidate, rerun final matrix, sanitize evidence, and close out
acceptance: runtimeCandidate binds final source/tree/runtime after the last repair; distributionCandidate binds exact package/image bytes without assuming CI artifact equivalence.
All invalidated final cases rerun and deferred rows remain pending.
All processes/handles/listeners close, raw campaign root is deleted, a sanitized evidence ledger remains, and Repository is clean and pushed.

tasks.title: Pass the Goal completion checker and prepare the human release proposal
acceptance: Before checkpoint, the machine checker passes with --exclude-task P17-T07; after the pushed checkpoint it passes again without exclusion.
Machine checker proves required tasks, runtimeCandidate/distributionCandidate and evidence identity, full verify, origin sync, cleanup, and no secret residue.
Release proposal separates proven claims, pending platform/production claims, and exact human actions.
Goal completes without main push, tag, production signing, publication, or GitHub artifact download.

tasks.title: Human-approved stable promotion, signing, tag, and publication
acceptance: Run only after a new explicit human approval of exact candidate, main modification, actions, and production credentials.
Not part of the autonomous implementation and qualification Goal.
